paragraphs.source_en: look upon it. Enemy as he was, Porcupine had a much more picturesque face. I remember at the time of my father's funeral I saw a face much like his in the hanging picture on the hall of the Temple called Yogenji, Kobinata, Tokyo. On inquiry, the priest told me that the owner of the countenance was the monster named Itaten. Anger that day made his eyes big and round like an owl's, which he frequently focused at me. I was not to be intimidated in that way. Defeat was what I disliked most. Opening my eyes as wide as I possibly could, I stared him in the face. It is true the shape of my eyes is not so attractive, but as for their size, they beat everyone. "You will certainly make a great success as an actor, as you have such big eyes," Kiyo used to say.

units.source_en: Enemy as he was, Porcupine had a much more picturesque face.
I remember at the time of my father's funeral I saw a face much like his in the hanging picture on the hall of the Temple called Yogenji, Kobinata, Tokyo.
On inquiry, the priest told me that the owner of the countenance was the monster named Itaten.
Anger that day made his eyes big and round like an owl's, which he frequently focused at me.
I was not to be intimidated in that way.
